title: 有馬記念の後に・Sweet Memories

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion has won the Arima Kinen. Amidst the cheers, Daiwa Scarlet congratulates her on her victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, Air Shakur disparages her loss. She explains that while she was struggling against the conclusion her data foretold, she found hope watching Fine Motion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She believed that if she could stop Fine Motion from going home, it would prove that her own fate wasn't set in stone either. But in the end, the conclusion didn't change. Despite that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fine Motion picks up on Air Shakur's sheer determination and entrusts her with the task of changing the conclusion. And with that, she wishes her farewell.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's a press conference after the race, where Fine Motion announces her return to Ireland. As she speaks, her eyes glisten with tears…
